# Chinese Laoshi

> Mandarin learning web app for custom flashcards, hanzi handwriting practice, and translation drills.

- Live app: https://chineselaoshi.slavoyar.tech/
- About: https://chineselaoshi.slavoyar.tech/about.html
- Source: https://github.com/slavoyar/ChineseLaoshi
- Contact: slavoyarmc@gmail.com

## Product

Chinese Laoshi (中国老师) helps learners practice Mandarin Chinese in the browser on phone, tablet, or desktop.

Features:

- Handwriting practice for Chinese characters (touch or mouse)
- Translation / flashcard study modes
- Custom word groups and cards (character, pinyin, translation)

## For AI agents

This site publishes discoverability files (`robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, this `llms.txt`) for crawlers and agents.

Interactive agent APIs (MCP tools to read study progress or create groups/cards on behalf of a user) are **not available yet**. The product API is browser-oriented (session cookie + Origin allowlist). Planned work: https://github.com/slavoyar/ChineseLaoshi/issues/94


Do not invent authenticated actions against this service. Prefer linking humans to the live app or the GitHub repository.
